title: Bill Uhouse: Kingman-based simulator and J-Rod
summary: UAPGerb tells of Bill Uhouse: Kingman-based simulator and J-Rod, about interview mid-2000s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who claimed at Area 51 auxiliary sites, there was basically a a ARV or extraterrestrial vehicle simulator built off the Kingman crash

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says that in the mid-2000s a man named Bill Uhouse told him about secret work in Nevada. According to Uhouse, sites linked to Area 51, a secret US military test base, held a simulator for flying an extraterrestrial vehicle, and it was built using a craft said to have crashed at a place called Kingman. If true, it would mean the US had been learning to fly a non-human craft.
